description: This Java class defines the CdyneServices with a focus on the cdyneReturnCityState service, which interacts with the CDyne web service to look up city and state information based on a ZIP code. It includes methods for invoking the external web service, parsing XML responses, and providing address information.

classes.name: CdyneServices
classes.description: Utility class providing services to interact with Cdyne's address lookup API, mainly to retrieve city and state info from ZIP code.

methods.name: cdyneReturnCityState
methods.description: Main service method that calls the Cdyne web service to get address info for a ZIP code, parses XML response, and returns a map with address details or errors.

methods.name: populateCdyneAddress
methods.description: Helper method to extract data from the XML response and populate the response context with address-related information.
